title: Greece January 1970: historical review and focus candidates
status: Design evidence; no runtime script and no unverified MD effect syntax.

snapshot.government: Military dictatorship; Papadopoulos prime minister, Zoitakis regent, Constantine II king in exile.
snapshot.economy: Strong 1969-1970 growth and relatively stable prices coexist with regional and structural weaknesses.
do_not_preload: ND and PASOK as existing 1970 parties
A fictitious unified democratic opposition government

papadopoulos.roles: Prime minister at start; regent only from 1972, president only from 1973.
papadopoulos.classification: Controlled opening and managed republic are historical; durable successful democratization under him is alternate history.

ioannidis.actor: Actual Ioannidis de facto control flag
ioannidis.roles: Security chief before takeover; not formal president or prime minister. Gizikis is a separate constitutional figure.
ioannidis.classification: Takeover 25 November 1973 was historical; no date installs him automatically.

karamanlis.actor: Karamanlis governing mandate after an actual civilian transition
karamanlis.roles: ERE-associated exile before 1974; Kanellopoulos is a distinct ERE leader. ND name only after actual foundation, historically 4 October 1974.
karamanlis.classification: 1974 transition and European accession are historical; earlier return and alternate policy priorities must be labelled.

centre.actor: Mavros and Centre Union hold an actual governing mandate
centre.roles: He was deputy premier and foreign minister in 1974, not prime minister of a majority Centre government.
centre.classification: Long independent Mavros government is alternate history.

andreas.actor: Andreas Papandreou controls the movement; governing mandate required for domestic economic reforms
andreas.roles: PAK is an opposition/resistance movement before 1974. PASOK founded 3 September 1974; first government 1981.
andreas.classification: 1981-1983 social reforms are historical directions; a 1970 PAK government is alternate history.

kke.actor: KKE government or legal KKE organizational process, as appropriate
kke.roles: Koligiannis initially; Florakis only after an actual party succession, historicallyDecember 1972. KKE illegal until 1974. Do not merge KKE and KKE Interior after the 1968 split.
kke.classification: Legalization is historical; a 1970s/1980s national KKE government is alternate history.

royal.actor: Monarchist mandate or restoration petition at entry. Constantine returns only after a successful actual settlement; later economic focuses require a restored government.
royal.roles: King in exile at start; Zoitakis regent, Papadopoulos government leader.
royal.classification: 1967 countercoup failed;1974 free referendum rejected monarchy. A successful restoration is explicitly alternate history.

starting_spirits.title: Constitutional Government in Suspension
starting_spirits.reason: Parliamentary safeguards and effective free elections remain suspended.
starting_spirits.mechanical_intent: Model a legitimacy deficit and reform cost. A managed ballot does not remove it.
starting_spirits.removal: Implemented freedoms and a genuinely competitive constitutional settlement.

starting_spirits.title: The Security State
starting_spirits.status: negative with short-term coercive regime control
starting_spirits.reason: Political policing, arbitrary detention and torture damage civil society.
starting_spirits.mechanical_intent: Separate coercive order from consent; visible institutional/diplomatic costs. No clean permanent combat/research bonus for torture.
starting_spirits.removal: End torture and arbitrary detention; independent inspection and sustained enforcement. Trials or limited reconciliation can differ.

starting_spirits.title: Outside Strasbourg
starting_spirits.reason: Greece withdrew from the Council of Europe 12 December 1969.
starting_spirits.mechanical_intent: Constrained European institutional credibility, not a total NATO embargo or complete disappearance of tourist income.
starting_spirits.removal: Credible constitutional reform plus external acceptance of readmission.

starting_spirits.title: Officers Above Institutions
starting_spirits.reason: Purges and privileges make personal officer loyalty central to government.
starting_spirits.mechanical_intent: Professional appointments compete with factional reliability; reform can anger military clients. Officers are not a homogeneous bloc.
starting_spirits.removal: Civilian oversight and professional appointments, or retain a costly patronage network with continuing faction risk.

starting_spirits.title: Uneven Modernisation
starting_spirits.reason: Agricultural underemployment and regional disparities coexist with strong aggregate growth.
starting_spirits.mechanical_intent: Province-specific development, training and credit bottlenecks; no national economic-collapse fiction or ethnic penalty.
starting_spirits.removal: Provincial infrastructure, farm productivity and productive investment beyond Greater Athens.

starting_spirits.title: Opposition in the Shadows
starting_spirits.reason: Detention, bans, exile and fragmented networks obstruct public competition.
starting_spirits.mechanical_intent: Suppressed opposition and legitimacy tension, not a fictitious mass uprising already underway inJanuary 1970.
starting_spirits.removal: Real organizing rights, releases, return and constitutional guarantees; repression has continuing consequences.

starting_spirits.title: Growth Linked to the World Economy
starting_spirits.status: mixed exposure, not a blanket starting debuff
starting_spirits.reason: Shipping, tourism, remittances and foreign capital help sustain growth.
starting_spirits.mechanical_intent: Keep real income strengths. Trigger later damage from actual external shocks, conflict or financing deterioration.
starting_spirits.removal: Diversification reduces exposure without erasing maritime strengths.

candidate_focuses.title: An Opening on Our Terms
candidate_focuses.conditions: Papadopoulos controls government; historical referenceApril 1970.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Open a limited reform process and civilian economic appointments.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Hardliners lose confidence; public promises create expectations.

candidate_focuses.title: A Civilian Economic Cabinet
candidate_focuses.conditions: Real civilian economic authority and independent advice are accepted.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Better administration and investment credibility.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Surrender military discretion; retained security powers prevent full legitimacy recovery.

candidate_focuses.title: The Five-Year Plan by Decree
candidate_focuses.conditions: Continue junta-led 1968-1972 investment planning without parliamentary budget control.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Accelerate approved industrial/tourism projects.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Patronage and external financing exposure remain; no penalty attached to every ordinary building focus.

candidate_focuses.title: A Republic Under Supervision
candidate_focuses.conditions: OR prerequisite; government actually chooses constitutional change. Historical contextJune-July 1973; earlier timing explicitly alternate.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Consolidate a managed presidential arrangement.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Controlled plebiscite does not create democratic consent; Crown and military rivals retain agency.

candidate_focuses.title: The Invisible Strongman
candidate_focuses.conditions: Ioannidis actually wins an internal contest; never automatic 25 November 1973.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Establish de facto control and hardline policy options.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Keep formal office distinct; renewed repression damages credibility.

candidate_focuses.title: Barracks Procurement Boards
candidate_focuses.conditions: Military procurement oversight and financing approved.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Prioritize domestic repairs, ammunition and military contracts.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Budget concentration and political allocation divert civilian resources.

candidate_focuses.title: Professional Logistics Under Watch
candidate_focuses.conditions: Accept professional logistical authority within the regime.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Better depots, maintenance and audited procurement.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Forego faster discretionary contracts and patronage leverage of alternative.

candidate_focuses.title: Demand a Veto in Nicosia
candidate_focuses.conditions: OR prerequisite; CYP exists and a real officer/influence dispute exists.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Open an interference/escalation proposal.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Cypriot refusal, domestic backlash and Turkish counteraction remain possible.
candidate_focuses.external_agency: CYP controls its response; TUR controls its response. No guaranteed coup, enosis or leader/state transfer.

candidate_focuses.title: A Government of National Unity
candidate_focuses.conditions: Actual civilian transition and accepted Karamanlis mandate; party outlook alone insufficient.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Start constitutional reconstruction and economic confidence.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Domestic settlement required; dictatorship cannot claim this benefit without yielding authority.

candidate_focuses.title: European Investment Guarantees
candidate_focuses.conditions: Enforceable investment/competition guarantees adopted.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Private investment, tourism finance and technical imports.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Competition exposure and less discretionary subsidy spending.

candidate_focuses.title: Strategic Public Holdings
candidate_focuses.conditions: Parliament approves finance and oversight of strategic holdings.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Protect selected infrastructure and production through public investment.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Recurring fiscal commitments and slower restructuring; no total private-enterprise ban.

candidate_focuses.title: The Accession Mandate
candidate_focuses.conditions: OR prerequisite; constitutional guarantees and real negotiation progress. Historical treaty 1979, membership 1981.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Request a market-access/development framework.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Adjustment and treaty obligations; no instant membership or free foreign factories.
candidate_focuses.external_agency: European counterpart actors accept, delay or attach conditions. Greece cannot compel accession.

candidate_focuses.title: The Centre Reassembled
candidate_focuses.conditions: Centre networks legal; Mavros actually holds a governing mandate.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Rebuild parliamentary and provincial organization.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Coalition formation takes time; foreign-minister appointment is not the premiership.

candidate_focuses.title: Regional Enterprise Credit
candidate_focuses.conditions: Audited provincial small-enterprise lending funded.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Diversify employment beyond Greater Athens.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Guarantees create repayment/budget exposure; no invented universal corruption penalty.
candidate_focuses.historical_classification: counterfactual response to real structural need

candidate_focuses.title: A Cooperative Rural Compact
candidate_focuses.conditions: Voluntary producers accept credit and marketing arrangements.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Farm productivity and producer bargaining power.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Slower initial urban returns; local consent and administration required.
candidate_focuses.historical_classification: counterfactual response to real structural need

candidate_focuses.title: Parliamentary Economic Oversight
candidate_focuses.conditions: OR prerequisite; elected parliament and public audit procedures function.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Reduce patronage costs and sustain negotiated development.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Forego unchecked executive spending; no instant universal cure.

candidate_focuses.title: From PAK to a Mass Party
candidate_focuses.conditions: Actual organizing opening and Andreas movement control. PASOK label requires real foundation, historically 3 September 1974.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Bring exile/domestic networks into public organization.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Organization does not itself finance economic promises; domestic reforms need governing authority.

candidate_focuses.title: Socialise Strategic Enterprises
candidate_focuses.conditions: Andreas party actually governs; lawful mandate, compensation and finance approved.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Public leverage over strategic production/social investment.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Compensation, managers and investor uncertainty affect funding.

candidate_focuses.title: Productive Investment with Worker Representation
candidate_focuses.conditions: Government negotiates a funded labour/industry pact.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Training, labour participation and targeted productive expansion.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Retain mixed ownership and negotiate with firms instead of direct asset command.

candidate_focuses.title: A National Health Service
candidate_focuses.conditions: OR prerequisite; real mandate, trained staff and recurring funding. Historical modelLaw 1397/1983.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Accessible care and civilian resilience through actual MD health mechanics.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Recurring staffing/fiscal costs; no free universal service without capacity.

candidate_focuses.title: From Clandestinity to Legality
candidate_focuses.conditions: Actual legal organizing rights or an explicitly alternate KKE government; distinguish opposition tasks from governing policies.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Replace underground constraints with public organization.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: No cosmetic legalization; do not merge the 1968 split or make Florakis 1970 secretary.

candidate_focuses.title: A Worker-Controlled Industrial Plan
candidate_focuses.conditions: KKE government holds a mandate and funds trained management.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Concentrate investment in production and organized labour.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Ownership transition, allocation and external finance impose costs.

candidate_focuses.title: Voluntary Agricultural Cooperatives
candidate_focuses.conditions: KKE government has authority; participation is explicitly voluntary.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Storage, rural output and cooperative marketing.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Forego concentrated industrial priority; no automatic seizure of every small farm.

candidate_focuses.title: Negotiate Eastern Development Credits
candidate_focuses.conditions: OR prerequisite; competent Greek government submits actual terms.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Request machinery, training and development credit.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Repayment and dependence; refusal and narrower terms remain possible.
candidate_focuses.external_agency: USSR/other partners independently accept. No automatic Warsaw Pact membership.

candidate_focuses.title: Put the Crown to a Free Vote
candidate_focuses.conditions: Actual constitutional opening permits a genuine referendum; focus completion cannot predetermine victory.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: A legitimate constitutional decision process.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Respect rejection; historical 1974 result was republican.

candidate_focuses.title: A Crown Bound by Parliament
candidate_focuses.conditions: A genuine settlement actually restored the Crown under elected government.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Investment predictability and reduced constitutional ambiguity.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Crown relinquishes independent political discretion and officer patronage.

candidate_focuses.title: A Palace Development Council
candidate_focuses.conditions: Restoration succeeded; player explicitly chooses an executive/patronage settlement.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Concentrate elite and maritime investment networks.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Constitutional conflict, favoritism and weak oversight persist.

candidate_focuses.title: A Royal Investment Appeal
candidate_focuses.conditions: OR prerequisite; enforceable contracts and actual investor subscriptions.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Finance subscribed port, shipping-support or provincial projects.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: No conjured royal fortune, automatic private investment or universal loyalty.

candidate_focuses.title: An Aegean Exploration Protocol
candidate_focuses.conditions: Survey capability and real overlapping-claims context. Modern exploration dispute begins 1973-1974, not a completed 1970 crisis.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Open deconfliction/joint procedure versus higher-risk unilateral surveys.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Surveys cost money and may not find viable deposits; claims remain contested.
candidate_focuses.external_agency: TUR controls licensing, negotiation and naval response. No automatic war, free oil or sovereign transfer.

candidate_focuses.title: Clarify the Cyprus Chain of Command
candidate_focuses.conditions: CYP exists and a relevant officer, contingent or guarantee relationship remains.
candidate_focuses.reward_intent: Offer agreed command rules, officer withdrawal or a bilateral sovereignty-respecting arrangement.
candidate_focuses.tradeoff_intent: Recipient can refuse; interference can damage legitimacy and create crisis.
candidate_focuses.external_agency: CYP chooses its government response; TUR/other guarantors decide separately. No automatic coup, invasion, enosis or victory.

principles: A party/outlook condition and actual leader/faction control are separate tests.
Government economic reforms need real governing authority. Opposition organization does not grant a ministry or change government by itself.
Historical dates constrain historical labels and provide reference chronology. Explicit alternate-history rules can depart; no automatic coups, elections, foreign agreements or wars.
Put meaningful costs in strategic choices and financing, not arbitrary drawbacks on every ordinary focus.
Coercion, torture and civilian harm are described honestly. No ethnicity is an inherent national penalty.
Numerical values and actual MD/Imperia effect codes must be verified by the mechanics agent. Suggested effects here are semantic design targets.
Domestic priorities may grant stronger small-country specialization benefits once real local capacity and funding exist.

layout_guidance.internal_pattern: Entry -> two symmetric economic/governance priorities -> capstone with OR prerequisite. Separate shared foreign-policy corridor.
layout_guidance.spacing: Use positioning agent's verified MD generic/Russia convention; generous lane gaps and empty routing corridors. This historian file imposes no x/y coordinates.
layout_guidance.mutual_exclusions: Choice groups are strategic priorities, not a claim that a mixed economy cannot contain both public and private sectors.
layout_guidance.warning: The royal vote has an honest possible republican outcome. Its two restoration follow-ups remain unavailable if restoration is rejected.

conditional_later_factors.context: Law School/Polytechnic 1973. Activate from actual protest and coercive response; not an initial 1970 mass revolt.
Later 1972-1974 deterioration and external shocks; not a January 1970 depression.
Independent CYP/TUR/GRE choices, multiple military actors and civilian harm. No guaranteed successful coup or inevitable war.
Transition, negotiating mandate,1979 treaty and 1981 accession are distinct stages.

limitations: GAK references are finding aids, not verified scans of complete fonds.
PASOK programme source is an official retrospective; original 1974 manifesto scan not retrieved.
KKE source confirms December 1972 succession but does not justify an invented exact day.
US forecasts and legal positions of disputing states must be attributed.
Mavros-led, KKE-led and royal-restoration governments are scenario alternatives, not actual 1970s Greek governments.

historical_timeline_not_scheduled_events.fact: Failed royal countercoup, followed by Constantine exile.
Papadopoulos announced liberalization measures; implementation was limited.
KKE chose Florakis at 17th Plenum; initial leader was Koligiannis.
Managed plebiscite; not equivalent to the free 1974 referendum.
Military repression at Polytechnic and martial law.
Ioannidis-backed coup ousted Papadopoulos; formal PresidentGizikis and PMAndroutsopoulos remained distinct.
Cyprus coup triggered diplomatic crisis; Greek governmental and military involvement must not be hidden behind an ethnic narrative.
Free referendum rejected monarchy 69.18%. Successful restoration is alternate history.
EEC accession treaty signed; membership effective 1 January 1981 after ratification.

shared_economic_design_requirements.access: Every government, not reserved to the royal branch.
shared_economic_design_requirements.choice: Shipowner foreign-exchange/registration incentives versus domestic ports, repair and seafarer training.
shared_economic_design_requirements.constraints: Merchant tonnage is not a free navy. Overseas ownership/foreign flags do not automatically create Greek factories or tax revenue. Negotiate investment and legal guarantees, with labour/fiscal costs.

shared_economic_design_requirements.choice: Rapid hotel/coastal investment versus coordinated infrastructure, water and local services.
shared_economic_design_requirements.constraints: Tourism grew despite foreign criticism of the junta. Leaving the Council of Europe did not delete all tourist income. External demand and actual war can change outcomes.

shared_economic_design_requirements.access: Every government, with extra political specialization.
shared_economic_design_requirements.choice: Athens/Piraeus industry concentration versus provincial infrastructure, agriculture, storage and enterprise credit.
shared_economic_design_requirements.constraints: Do not place modern oil fields or factories in arbitrary states. Actual state IDs/sites need mechanical and historical verification.
